basic_info.description:
Step into timeless San Francisco charm with this freshly remodeled home in the highly desirable Outer Richmond neighborhood, just steps from Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach. This 2-bedroom, 1-bath single-family residence blends classic 1920s architecture with today’s latest design trends. The gourmet kitchen features brand-new appliances and modern finishes, while the updated bathroom adds a touch of luxury.

Enjoy rare city amenities like garage parking, a private driveway for additional parking, and a generously sized backyard—perfect for entertaining, gardening, or exploring future ADU potential. A landscaped yard and a spacious, usable basement offer added storage or expansion possibilities.

This home is truly turn-key and move-in ready. Nestled in a family-friendly community with easy access to iconic SF attractions like the de Young Museum, Sutro Baths, Lands End Trail, and vibrant local eateries on Balboa and Clement Street.

Don't miss your chance to own a piece of classic San Francisco with modern comfort and convenience.
